    Getting around

    Orbit: look at the house or a part of it from outside
    DragOrbit around the centre point
    Right-drag, Shift+drag, two fingersPan
    Scroll / pinchZoom toward the cursor
    Double-clickMake that point the centre and move in on it
    WASD / arrows, Q ESlide the view; down / up
    Walk: move through the rooms at eye height (press 2, or Walk)
    DragLook around
    W S / ↑ ↓Walk forward / back (scroll does the same)
    A D · ← →Step sideways · turn
    ShiftHold to move 3× faster
    Double-clickGo there: a floor point, or stand 2'-6" in front of a wall or fixture; on a door, walk through it to the other side
    Q EFly down / up (turns off "stay on the floor"; G lands again)
    Both
    ClickInspect an element; click the same spot again to pick what is behind it (framing behind a wall, say); F moves in on the selected one
    Sheet tagsClick a sheet tag (A1, S2…) in the selection panel to show everything that cites that sheet; where the drawings are available, the orange tag beside it opens that sheet
    ShowPresets switch the categories in one click; the Walls & ceilings slider sets how solid walls, cladding and ceilings look. The viewer remembers your settings in this browser; Reset view puts them back
    Plan mapClick to move there (walk) or to centre the view there (orbit); M shows / hides it
    1 / 2Orbit / Walk
    EscStop measuring, close the selection

    Walls do not stop you, so you can step through them to look inside. Measure works in both modes; set a section cut first to reach inside items.
